IF NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM sys.tables
    WHERE name = '@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}'
      AND schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}')
)
BEGIN

        tablename     VARCHAR(30)  NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
        last_updated  DATETIME    NOT NULL
    );
END

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] WHERE tablename = '@{item().TableName}') INSERT INTO [@{pipeline().parameters.schemaname}].[@{pipeline().parameters.watermarktablename}] (tablename, last_updated) VALUES ('@{item().TableName}', DATEADD(DAY, -@{pipeline().parameters.initial_lookback_days}, SYSUTCDATETIME()))

text.value: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys.tables WHERE name = 'latest_updated_summary' AND schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo')) BEGIN CREATE TABLE dbo.latest_updated_summary (tablename VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, last_updated DATETIME2 NOT NULL, is_latest BIT NOT NULL); END; TRUNCATE TABLE dbo.latest_updated_summary; WITH combined AS (SELECT source_table AS tablename, watermark_value AS last_updated FROM dbo.etl_watermark UNION ALL SELECT 'glaccount_ccode', '@{formatDateTime(activity('Lookup_GLAccount_MaxUpdatedTs').output.firstRow.NewWatermarkValue, 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss')}') INSERT INTO dbo.latest_updated_summary (tablename, last_updated, is_latest) SELECT tablename, last_updated, CASE WHEN last_updated = MAX(last_updated) OVER () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM combined;

SELECT * FROM Information_schema.Tables
where TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE'

SELECT TOP (1)
    s.name AS SchemaName,
    t.name AS TableName,
    SUM(p.rows) AS TotalRows
FROM sys.tables t
JOIN sys.schemas s
    ON t.schema_id = s.schema_id
JOIN sys.partitions p
    ON t.object_id = p.object_id
WHERE p.index_id IN (0,1)
GROUP BY
    s.name,
    t.name
ORDER BY
    TotalRows DESC;
